name: Exp_SpearmanRankCorrelation_Histogram_TimeWeekPeriod
summary: This EA uses the Spearman Rank Correlation indicator applied as a histogram to identify overbought/oversold conditions for mean reversion entries. It incorporates a TimeWeekPeriod filter that restricts trading to specific days or time windows within the week. Signals are generated when the correlation histogram crosses extreme threshold levels, indicating potential price reversals.
summary_zh: 该EA使用斯皮尔曼等级相关指标直方图来识别超买/超卖条件，进行均值回归入场。它结合了TimeWeekPeriod时间过滤器，将交易限制在每周的特定日期或时间窗口内。当相关系数直方图穿越极端阈值水平时产生信号，预示潜在的价格反转。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于斯皮尔曼等级相关系数(Spearman Rank Correlation)的均值回归交易。斯皮尔曼相关系数衡量的是价格序列的排序相关性，当该值达到极端高值或低值时，表明价格序列存在非随机性，即趋势过度延伸，大概率发生回归。入场条件为：当直方图值超过上限阈值时做空，低于下限阈值时做多，反映超买超卖状态。出场条件依赖于反向信号或固定的止盈止损设置。仓位管理方面，该EA使用固定手数交易，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面没有集成风险百分比计算或权益保护逻辑。TimeWeekPeriod时间过滤器是一个特色功能，它允许用户选择在每周的特定时段交易，从而避开低流动性或高波动时段。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is mean reversion trading based on the Spearman Rank Correlation coefficient. The Spearman correlation measures the rank-order correlation of price series; when it reaches extreme high or low values, it indicates non-randomness in the price sequence, meaning the trend is overextended and likely to revert. Entry conditions are: sell when the histogram value exceeds the upper threshold and buy when it falls below the lower threshold, reflecting overbought and oversold states respectively. Exit conditions rely on reverse signals or fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management lacks integrated risk percentage calculation or equity protection logic. The TimeWeekPeriod filter is a distinctive feature that allows users to restrict trading to specific time windows within the week, avoiding low liquidity or high volatility periods.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: SpearmanPeriod
parameters.description: 斯皮尔曼相关系数计算周期

parameters.name: LevelHigh
parameters.description: 超买阈值上限，超过此值做空

parameters.name: LevelLow
parameters.description: 超卖阈值下限，低于此值做多

parameters.name: TimeWeekPeriod
parameters.description: 周内时间过滤周期参数

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损点数，0为不使用

pros: 斯皮尔曼等级相关系数是非参数统计指标，对价格异常值不敏感，比普通相关指标更稳健
TimeWeekPeriod时间过滤器能有效避开不利交易时段，提高策略在活跃时段的胜率
均值回归逻辑在震荡市中有较好的表现，与趋势跟踪策略形成互补
pros_en: Spearman Rank Correlation is a non-parametric statistical indicator, less sensitive to price outliers and more robust than standard correlation measures
The TimeWeekPeriod filter effectively avoids unfavorable trading sessions, improving win rates during active periods
Mean reversion logic performs well in ranging markets, complementing trend-following strategies
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势市场中容易持续亏损，缺乏趋势过滤机制
固定手数交易缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据账户风险或市场波动调整头寸
止盈止损默认值为0，存在不带止损直接交易的风险，可能导致大幅亏损
cons_en: Mean reversion strategy is prone to consecutive losses in strong trending markets, lacking a trend filter mechanism
Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, unable to adjust positions based on account risk or market volatility
Default stop-loss and take-profit values are 0, posing risk of trading without protection and potentially leading to large drawdowns
improvements: 增加趋势过滤指标（如ADX或移动平均线），在强趋势市场中暂停均值回归交易
实现基于账户权益百分比的动态仓位管理，并设置最大回撤保护
improvements_en: Add a trend filter indicator (such as ADX or moving average) to suspend mean reversion trading during strong trending markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage with maximum drawdown protection

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为0，可能在极端行情中造成重大亏损
均值回归策略在趋势市中存在逆势交易风险，缺少趋势保护机制
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, which may cause significant losses during extreme market moves
Mean reversion strategy carries counter-trend trading risk in trending markets, lacking trend protection mechanism
